smallest_supported_claim: The repaired live route accepted native selection and activation of the currently advertised smoke-grenade item, and one ordinary staffed-camp cadence recorded a source-matched smoke observation and created the exact smoke-signal lead. A later native activation after moving across the adjacent OMT boundary reached a no-source cadence, and a native six-hour wait reached game minute 8592.
causal_account: J0001 binds the run to the registered scenario, source, executable, and cockpit session. J0060 and J0064 show the advertised inventory owner/action and the green R008 smoke-only observation at game minute 8225, with sound and light absent; the immutable transition log records sequence 56 as a source-matched smoke lead creation at OMT (140,40,0), observer 18, and sequence 133 at game minute 8230 as no_signal_source with unchanged lead count/hash. The second activation was therefore not an unchanged-source repeat: it crossed the OMT boundary and the subsequent cadence had no usable source. J0223 records accepted native wait.6h and J0222 records the resulting game minute 8592 observation. The six-hour interval demonstrates continued observation after the no-source boundary, but does not by itself prove lead aging/removal.

citations.meaning: Immutable scenario/run/binding identity for the registered R-033 session.

Native inventory surface advertised the smoke grenade owner and an enabled stable activate target; R008 recorded smoke observed at (140,40,0) and (140,41,0) at game minute 8225, with sound/light absent.
Accepted native activation returned to the World surface at game minute 8225 with the active smoke item and the same green channel audit.
Native wait.6h was advertised and accepted.
Post-wait native observation reached game minute 8592.

remaining_unknowns: Whether an unchanged, same-source second cadence performs dedup while preserving the exact lead identity and count/hash.
Whether the retained source-matched lead ages out or is removed after six hours; the run only established a six-hour observation after the no-source boundary.
How the pre-existing terrain-opportunity leads affect the aggregate lead count independently of the source-matched smoke lead.
contradictions: The second activation changed the source across the adjacent OMT boundary; the next cadence recorded no_signal_source rather than an unchanged-source callback.
The six-hour wait followed a no-source boundary, so it cannot establish aging or removal of the source-matched lead.
